Phase 7 tasks (T041-T044) are revision tasks that must be completed before T013, T013b, and T013c are executed in production. However, Phase 7 is listed AFTER Phase 3 (US1) in the task list. This creates a semantic violation: the tasks that fix the data sources (T041, T042) and create the fallback (T043) are placed after the tasks that use them (T013, T013b, T013c). T041-T044 must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or before Phase 3 to ensure the data sources are resolved before ingestion tasks run.
